basic_info.description: This. Is. The. One!  Welcome to 1460 7th Ave.  Located two blocks from Golden Gate Park in the vibrant Inner Sunset neighborhood this full  floor flat is one of the properties that Checks The Boxes''.  This home features three bedrooms, two full bathrooms and beautiful hardwood floors. The  primary bedroom enjoys an en suite bathroom. The kitchen has beautiful new quartz countertops,  stainless steel appliances and a large stainless-steel sink. You will enjoy indoor/outdoor living  with a quaint porch off the dining area and private deck and patio that look out to Mount Sutro.  Past your deck and patio is a spacious shared backyard landscaped with hydrangeas, a Meyer  lemon tree, and roses.  The condo comes complete with a two-car garage that offers plenty of storage and a private  laundry closet.  1460 7th Ave is one of those properties that will make the most discerning buyer happy to call  home.  Welcome home.
